title: GET /api/sessions (this schema's root) and POST /api/sessions/<resume|mark|delete>
description: Claude Code sessions kuhy started by hand (headless runs, entrypoint sdk-cli and sdk-py, are never listed), read from ~/.claude/projects. `status` comes from the tag line of the last reply; `done` also counts a manual mark in ~/.claude/session-status.json; `group` is the server's urgency rank (0 needs_action, 1 question, 2 untagged, 3 running, 4 done or continuing), and the list arrives sorted by it, newest first. POSTs send Content-Type application/json, X-Todoimpl-Token and a same-origin Origin like every other action; the body is `resume_body`, `mark_body` or `delete_body`, the answer is `result`.

session_id.description: Canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID, the only spelling the mutations accept.

session.description: One session. Title, prompt and reply are the user's own content (last_user cut to 400 characters, last_assistant to its last 600).

mark.description: How the row stands: marked done by hand, done by its own status tag, or not done.

last_ts.description: ISO time of the newest prompt or reply.

resume_command.description: `cd '<cwd>' && claude --resume <id>`, single-quoted for a POSIX shell.

resume_body.description: One `id`, or `ids` (1 to 5). Opens a terminal per session in its transcript's cwd.

mark_body.description: `mark` done sets the manual mark, null clears it. All-or-nothing over `ids`.

delete_body.description: Moves transcripts to ~/.claude/projects-trash/<date>/; never unlinks, refuses any id written in the last 10 minutes. All-or-nothing over `ids`.

result.description: HTTP 200 whether the guard allowed it or not. `refused` is the guard doing its job (nothing was changed), not a crash; `ok` false with `refused` false means it could not be attempted. 400 and 403 use the common error shape instead.
